_about: Verified ServiceNow terminology reference used by the reviewer agent. Every entry must cite an official ServiceNow source (servicenow.com or servicenow.com/docs). Add new terms only after verifying them in official documentation. Terms with enforce_case=true are official product names or acronyms whose exact capitalization is checked.

core_terms.description: Enterprise platform for managing and automating workflows.
core_terms.notes: One word, capital S and capital N. Not 'Service Now' or 'Servicenow'.

A task associated with fulfilling a requested item.

interface_labels._notes: Common form fields, modules, and buttons. Labels may be customized per instance, so unfamiliar labels should be flagged for manual review rather than treated as errors. Do not translate these labels unless an official translation is verified or the document clearly uses a translated interface.
